disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorders; clinical cohort applied to the normative model of cortical thickness asymmetry index.

dataset-of-origin.detail: ASD data drawn from 7 scan sites: ABIDE-I (NYU, USM), ABIDE-II (GU, OHSU), MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD. MITASD, WASHASD, and MADRID-ASD are not in the normalization keyword list and are therefore not included in the answer array.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II datasets include low quality T1 data..." / Supplemental Table 2 lists sites: ABIDE-I NYU, ABIDE-I USM, ABIDE-II GU, ABIDE-II OHSU, MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD
dataset-of-origin.location: Echave2024.pdf.md: Methods / Image processing, L81; Echave2024_sup.docx.md: Supplemental Table 2, L61-L83

age.detail: Age statistics not reported separately for ASD. The combined cases (ASD+SZ) age range is 7–65 years, reported only as the range encompassed by the training set normative model. Supplemental Table 1 (not available in provided files) would contain per-site demographics.
age.supporting_text: "The age range encompassed the age range of the cases (range: 7-65 years)."

sex.detail: Only male percentage (83%) was reported. female_n estimated by subtracting male_n from total N (135 − 112 = 23). male_n derived as round(135 × 0.83) = 112. female_pct = 23/135 × 100 = 17.0%.

disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; clinical cohort applied to the normative model of cortical thickness asymmetry index.

dataset-of-origin.detail: SZ data drawn from 3 scan sites: BGS, COBRE, UTRECHT. COBRE and Utrecht are in the normalization keyword list. BGS is not in the normalization keyword list and is therefore not included in the answer array.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The BGS and COBRE datasets have undergone extensive quality control procedures (Chopra et al., 2023)" / "For the Utrecht dataset images also underwent extensive quality control"
dataset-of-origin.location: Echave2024.pdf.md: Methods / Image processing, L81; Echave2024_sup.docx.md: Supplemental Table 2, L61-L83

age.detail: Age statistics not reported separately for SZ. The combined cases (ASD+SZ) age range is 7–65 years, reported only as the range encompassed by the training set normative model. Supplemental Table 1 (not available in provided files) would contain per-site demographics.
age.supporting_text: "The age range encompassed the age range of the cases (range: 7-65 years)."

sex.detail: Only male percentage (81%) was reported. female_n estimated by subtracting male_n from total N (287 − 232 = 55). male_n derived as round(287 × 0.81) = 232. female_pct = 55/287 × 100 = 19.2%.
